subject: general
question:
Select the option with the correct spelling that can replace the underlined word in the given sentence. If the spelling in the given sentence is already correct, choose Option “No replacement required”.

The office was full of __sychopants__ eager to flatter the boss.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. sycophants .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence contains the word **sychopants**, which is incorrectly spelled.
 
• The correct spelling for the word is **sycophants**, which refers to people who flatter someone in authority for personal gain.
 
• Among the options, Option 3 has the correct spelling, "sycophants."

Correct sentence: *The office was full of sycophants eager to flatter the boss.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meaning of Sycophant:** A person who acts obsequiously toward someone important in order to gain advantage.
 
• **Example Usage:** "She surrounded herself with sycophants who praised her every decision."
